name: Motivational
intro: You showed up. That's the first victory.
Whatever brought you here today, whether it was hard or heavy, you chose yourself. And that takes strength.
Take a deep breath in. Fill your lungs completely.
And release. Let it all go.
Right now, in this moment, you are choosing to grow.
body: Think about everything you've already survived.
Every hard day. Every sleepless night. Every moment you thought you couldn't keep going.
And yet here you are. Still standing. Still breathing. Still fighting.
You are more resilient than you give yourself credit for.
Breathe that in. You are strong.
Now imagine the version of yourself you're becoming.
Not perfect. Not finished. But growing. Evolving.
See that person clearly. How they move. How they speak. How they carry themselves.
That person isn't far away. They're already inside you.
Every small step you take brings them closer to the surface.
Fear is not a wall. It's a doorway.
The things that scare you the most are often the things that matter the most.
You don't have to be fearless. You just have to be willing.
Willing to try. Willing to fail. Willing to try again.
Courage isn't the absence of fear. It's moving forward with it.
You are not defined by your worst moments.
You are defined by how you rise after them.
Think of one thing you're proud of. It doesn't have to be big.
Maybe you were kind when it was hard to be. Maybe you kept a promise to yourself.
Hold that. That's evidence of who you really are.
The world needs what only you can offer.
Your voice. Your perspective. Your unique way of seeing things.
No one else has lived your story. No one else can tell it.
You are not too much. You are not too little. You are exactly right.
Breathe deeply and know this: you've got this.
closing: As you come back to the room, carry this energy with you.
You are capable. You are worthy. You are already on your way.
Take one more deep breath. Feel your power.
Slowly open your eyes. The world is waiting for you.
Go gently, but go boldly. You've got this.
